title: Classic Meatloaf
description: Tender ground beef baked with a savory tomato glaze.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, diced onion, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Shape into a loaf in a baking dish.
Spread ketchup over top and bake for 55 minutes.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Thighs
description: Crispy seasoned bone-in chicken thighs roasted to perfection.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Pat chicken dry and rub with olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Place on a baking sheet and bake for 35-40 minutes until skin is golden and internal temp reaches 165°F.

title: Hearty Beef Stew
description: Slow-simmered tender beef chunks with potatoes and carrots in rich broth.
instructions: Sear beef chunks in a pot until browned on all sides.
Add chopped onion, potatoes, and carrots.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low heat for 1.5 hours until beef is fork-tender.

title: Spaghetti & Meatballs
description: Classic pasta topped with savory meatballs and marinara sauce.
instructions: Boil spaghetti according to package directions.
Roll ground beef into meatballs and pan-fry until fully cooked.
Simmer meatballs in marinara sauce for 10 minutes.
Serve sauce and meatballs over spaghetti with parmesan cheese.

title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
description: Juicy pork chops seared with butter and thyme.
instructions: Season pork chops generously with salt and pepper.
Heat skillet over medium-high heat with butter and garlic.
Sear pork chops 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.

title: Shepherd's Pie
description: Savory ground beef and vegetables topped with creamy mashed potatoes.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet and drain fat.
Stir in beef gravy, corn, and peas.
Transfer to baking dish and spread mashed potatoes over top.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes until potatoes turn lightly golden.

title: Garlic Butter Salmon
description: Tender salmon fillets pan-seared with garlic butter and lemon.
instructions: Season salmon with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in skillet over medium-high heat and add minced garlic.
Sear salmon skin-side up for 4 minutes, flip, and cook 3-4 more minutes until flaky.

title: Roast Chicken with Potatoes
description: Whole roasted chicken served with golden garlic-herb potatoes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Rub chicken with melted butter, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Arrange quartered potatoes around chicken in a roasting pan.
Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes until internal chicken temperature reaches 165°F.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
description: Tender chicken strips and fresh vegetables tossed in a simple soy glaze.
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.
Slice chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a wok or skillet.
Add broccoli florets and soy sauce; stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until broccoli is tender-crisp.
Serve hot over rice.

title: Beef Taco Bowl
description: Seasoned ground beef served over rice with cheese and salsa.
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet, drain excess fat, and stir in taco seasoning with 1/4 cup water.
Divide cooked rice into bowls.
Top with taco beef, shredded cheddar cheese, and salsa.

title: Baked Macaroni & Cheese
description: Rich and creamy baked pasta topped with melted cheddar.
instructions: Boil macaroni pasta until al dente.
Melt butter in pot, whisk in milk and 1.5 cups cheese until smooth sauce forms.
Combine pasta and cheese sauce in baking dish.
Top with remaining cheese and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes.

title: Dutch Oven Beef Chili
description: Thick ground beef chili simmered on the stovetop with kidney beans and tomato sauce.
instructions: Brown ground beef and diced onion in a Dutch oven or large pot over medium heat.
Stir in kidney beans, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook on the stovetop for 40 minutes.

title: Pork Tenderloin with Gravy
description: Roast pork tenderloin sliced thin and smothered in rich pan gravy.
instructions: Season pork tenderloin with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Sear in skillet with butter until browned on all sides.
Transfer to 400°F (200°C) oven for 20 minutes until internal temp reaches 145°F.
Slice and top with warm gravy.

title: Chicken & Rice Casserole
description: Creamy baked chicken breasts with rice and veggies in one dish.
instructions: Combine rice, chicken broth, and mixed vegetables in a casserole dish.
Place seasoned chicken breasts on top.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 45 minutes until rice is tender.

title: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
description: Crispy golden grilled cheese sandwich paired with warm tomato soup.
instructions: Butter bread slices and sandwich cheese in between.
Toast sandwiches in skillet over medium heat until golden brown and cheese is melted.
Heat tomato soup in saucepan and serve together.
